## Summary

Describe the change and the problem it solves.

## Related issue

Closes #

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Automation or workflow
- [ ] Refactor
- [ ] Security

## Evidence model impact

- [ ] No change to hashes, eligibility, award rule, receipts, or lifecycle
- [ ] Domain logic changed and tests were added or updated
- [ ] Receipt schema changed with parser and verifier coverage
- [ ] Storage schema changed with migration behavior documented

## Verification

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run typecheck`
- [ ] `npm run check:links`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] `npm run screenshots` if the interface changed

## Screenshots

Attach updated screenshots from `docs/screenshots/` when the interface changed.

## Checklist

- [ ] No seeded tenders, bids, awards, or receipts were introduced.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or private keys were added.
- [ ] User-facing behavior is documented.
- [ ] The change follows the Evidence Ledger design language.
- [ ] The pull request is focused and reviewable.
